item.title: Evaluation of machine-learning and deep-learning SPEI drought forecasts against persistence across timescales and lead times in Bangladesh
item.description:
Authors: Mahir Ahnaf, Showmitra Kumar Sarkar

Bangladesh, home to nearly 178 million people, is highly vulnerable to recurring droughts that threaten food security and rural livelihoods. Machine-learning and deep-learning models are increasingly used to forecast drought indices such as the Standardized Precipitation Evapotranspiration Index (SPEI). Most studies report accuracy without a persistence reference, although accumulated indices are strongly autocorrelated, and seldom test drought detection, longer leads or variation between training runs

要点：
- 数据：包含再分析/卫星/观测等来源。
- 方法：采用机器学习/深度学习模型。
- 任务：降尺度/预报/临近预测等应用场景。

item.title: Auditing Learned Dynamics in Weather Models
item.description:
Authors: Skylar Gu, Christina Last

Learned weather models are experimentally accessible computational systems whose internal representations can be inspected and manipulated. Using sparse autoencoder features from GraphCast, DeepMind's autoregressive weather forecasting model, we test whether causal relevance requires physical semantics, a question that matters for auditing whether AI forecasters used in high-assurance settings rely on reliable mechanisms. We also look at whether physically associated latent directions can be steered to improve extreme-event forecasts, where interventions are applied to the model's internal act

要点：
- 方法：采用机器学习/深度学习模型。
- 任务：降尺度/预报/临近预测等应用场景。

item.title: Temporal Extrapolation of Elastic Seismic Wave Propagation in Layered Media Using Neural Operators
item.description:
Authors: Dibyajyoti Nayak, Yuze Pu, Kami Mohammadi, Somdatta Goswami

Temporal prediction of seismic velocity fields beyond the time interval represented in training remains challenging for neural operator models. This study develops a coupled neural operator framework for stress-conditioned temporal prediction in layered elastic media. A time-integrator-embedded Deep Operator Network (TI-DeepONet) advances the velocity field through an embedded fourth-order Runge-Kutta (RK4) scheme, while a Fourier Neural Operator (FNO) learns a residual correction to the predicted spatial field

要点：
- 方法：采用机器学习/深度学习模型。

item.title: A Verifier from the Past: Test-Time Compute for Time Series Foundation Models
item.description:
Authors: Arjun Choudhry, Aditya Narayanan, Raghav Mallampalli, Po-han Li, Sai Shankar Narasimhan, Raimi Shah, B. Aditya Prakash, Shubhankar Agarwal

Test-time compute (TTC) improves language models by spending additional inference compute to generate, verify, and select among candidate outputs, but this recipe has not transferred directly to time series forecasting. A language model can verify a proof or vote across samples, but a forecaster must be causal; it cannot use future information to score a candidate. - 方法：采用机器学习/深度学习模型。
- 任务：降尺度/预报/临近预测等应用场景。

item.title: Stability Bands for Feature Attribution: The Core, the Nucleolus and the Bargaining Set of Explained-Variance Games
item.description:
Authors: Fernando Delbianco, Fernando Tohmé

Shapley-value attributions are the default way of explaining machine-learning predictions in economics, but they report a single number per feature and say nothing about whether a coalition of features that jointly accounts for more than it receives could contest that allocation. We study feature attribution through the core, the nucleolus and the bargaining set of an explained-variance game, in which the worth of a set of features is the variance of the model's predictions that those features generate. - 任务：降尺度/预报/临近预测等应用场景。

item.title: When Objectives and Evaluators Disagree: Evaluating Transfer for Post-hoc Demographic Framing Mitigation
item.description:
Authors: Tunazzina Islam

Post-hoc rewriting is used to reduce demographic disparities in LLM-generated text when the source model is inaccessible. A rewrite can look successful merely because it improved its own target or satisfied its selector. We study this as a transfer problem on 660 gender pairs and 1,980 age contrasts of demographic-conditioned climate messages

要点：
- 方法：采用机器学习/深度学习模型。

item.title: Learning to Verify: Signature-Guided Training for Adaptive Adversarial Detection
item.description:
Authors: Arash Vashagh, Roozbeh Razavi-Far

Adversarial example detectors often fail when attackers explicitly attempt to bypass them. We propose a dual-model approach that keeps the original classifier fixed and trains a separate verifier to assess its predictions. During training, we identify patterns of internal neural network activations that distinguish genuine examples of each class from adversarial examples targeting that class

要点：
- 数据：包含再分析/卫星/观测等来源。
- 方法：采用机器学习/深度学习模型。

item.title: MS-Point: Multi-Modal Hierarchical Spectral Learning for Point Cloud Understanding
item.description:
Authors: Hai-tao Yu, Jun Xia

Point-image alignment learns useful object representations, but different local feature patterns can produce the same pooled descriptor and receive the same alignment signal. We introduce MS-Point, a cross-modal pretraining framework that directly supervises intermediate point features and their neighborhood responses. At selected encoder stages, we compute neighborhood averages and residuals before pooling and align their branch descriptors with image features

要点：
- 方法：采用机器学习/深度学习模型。

item.title: Falsifiable Compositional Reasoning in Time Series Forecasting
item.description:
Authors: Hao Xue

Time series foundation models as well as the language-guided analytical agents achieve strong accuracy on standard chronological benchmarks. However, models that rank highest on historical validation splits often degrade across non-stationary regime transitions. We hypothesise that this gap arises from using historical backtesting as an open-ended search and model-selection objective instead of using it to test pre-specified compositional assumptions

要点：
- 方法：采用机器学习/深度学习模型。
- 任务：降尺度/预报/临近预测等应用场景。
